density.note: disc of geodesic radius 3.5 edges, all weights 1, dragged 3 edges along the surface

erosion.note: 60 gestures, each: random seed vertex, geodesic smooth falloff of radius 3 mean edges, drag of 1.5 mean edges in a random tangent direction (geodesic_abs[project]); Phong alpha 0.5

drift.note: path spread: the same final drag (3.5 mean edges) reached straight, by a dog-leg and by a detour; jitter: 300 random steps of about 0.35 mean edges ending at zero drag

symmetry.note: seed on the +x side, geodesic falloff reaching across the plane; I = both halves solved independently (mirrored drag), M = driven half mirrored; drags of 3 mean edges

weights.note: weight bands by ring: 1 (rings 0-1), 0.5 (2-3), 0.25 (4-5), 0 (6-7); drag 2.5 mean edges

cursor.note: screen_follow 1.0 = the pivot ends under the cursor; front view, orthographic
